 Medium

 Print GTA 6 is rumored to have a file size of 210 GB (Image credit: Rockstar Games) With Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) about three weeks away, one question is on every PS5 owner's mind: how much space do I need? The latest claim comes from the X account @PlaystationSize, which says the game will take up 210 GB on PS5. Although Rockstar hasn't confirmed this, it is a notable figure, and could turn out to be accurate. In the section below, we take a detailed look at the GTA 6 file size details. GTA 6 file size revealed for PS5
 As per a post by @PlaystationSize, GTA 6 download size is going to be 210 GB. If the number holds, the game would be more than double the size of its predecessor. GTA 5 takes up around 95 GB on PS5, while the Enhanced PC version asks for 105 GB. By comparison, GTA 5 occupied roughly 17 GB on Xbox 360 when it first launched in 2013. That growth reflects how much bigger and more detailed modern open worlds have become. The 210 GB claim sits near the top of the range circulating before launch. An earlier leak, traced to the account GTA 6 Intel, pointed to just under 200 GB on PS5. A separate estimate for the PS5 version puts it at roughly 150 to 180 GB, with the Xbox figure higher. The numbers are all in the same ballpark, which suggests the final install will land somewhere between 150 and 230 GB. A leaker said the development build used in leaked gameplay clips is over 200 GB, but the retail download could be smaller once Rockstar trims the extra data. A development build isn't the same as the version you'll download, so don't treat it as a confirmed retail size. Will GTA 6 fit on your PS5?
 Most of the console's storage isn't actually available to you. A PS5 with 825 GB of raw storage leaves roughly 667 GB usable after system files. A 210 GB install would take about a third of that and leave around 457 GB for everything else. That's fine on its own, but it gets tight if you keep several large games installed, since many modern titles weigh in at 100 GB or more. If you're running low on space, consider these options: Delete games you've finished before the preload begins.
 Move rarely played titles to an external drive.
 Install an M.2 SSD expansion if your storage is nearly full.

 GTA 6 release and preload dates
 GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with preloading starting on November 12. That gives you a week to download the game before it unlocks. A file this big can take hours on a slower connection, so start the preload as soon as it opens and use a wired Ethernet connection if you can. GTA 6 physical copies
 GTA 6's physical edition is expected to be a box containing only a download code. A 210 GB game wouldn't fit on one disc anyway. Until Rockstar publishes the official size on the PlayStation Store, 210 GB is a credible but unconfirmed number. Plan for roughly 200 GB or more, clear some room now, and wait for the store listing before making final storage decisions.
